# A bill with no tax entry at all, applying the cost split of a payment whose
# tax was separated when it was paid.
#
# The bill posts only to `Expenses:Supplies:USD`, so the tax split is not a
# copy of any line of this bill and is left where it is. The link is allowed:
# what the company claimed as a tax credit is its own affair, and the bill
# says nothing about it.
#
# After the link the transaction is `A/P +100.00 / Liabilities:Tax:GST USD
# +13.00 / Liabilities:Credit Card USD −113.00` — a payment holding a plain
# liability split beside the card. Which of the two is the payment account is
# what the export has to get right, and the tax split comes first.
#
# What this fixture produces: the bill settled, paid on the card.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-NO-TAX-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-02-18
  entry:
    date: 2026-02-18
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-02-18
    due: 2026-03-18
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-NO-TAX-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-18
    amount: 100
    account: "Liabilities:Credit Card USD"
    txn_guid: "ccddeeff00112233445566778899aabb"
    txn_split_guid: "ddeeff00112233445566778899aabbcc"
